g.text: A synthetic 256x128 momentum buffer built to be low-rank-dominated, the way real ones are, and the same matrix after Muon's

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: five quintic Newton-Schulz steps (coefficients 3.4445, -4.7750, 2.0315). Newton-Schulz approximates the orthogonal factor of

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: the update, driving every singular value toward 1, so a step moves the weight matrix by a comparable amount in every direction

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: instead of being spent on the few the gradient happens to be largest in. It applies to 2-D hidden matrices only.
